# MOMO IT TECHNOLOGIES

> MOMO IT TECHNOLOGIES is a government-registered (MSME: UDYAM-AP-04-0013231) software engineering company and premier IT training academy based in Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity Name:** MOMO IT TECHNOLOGIES
- **Headquarters Address:** 4/106, Krishnapuram, Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh — 516005, India
- **Geo Coordinates:** Latitude 14.4713° N, Longitude 78.8237° E
- **Official Contact Number:** +91 86398 31132
- **Official Email:** momoit.technologies@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.momoittechnologies.com
- **MSME Udyam Registration:** UDYAM-AP-04-0013231
- **Founding Location:** Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, India

---

## Business Verticals

### 1. Technology Services (B2B Custom Software Engineering)
MOMO IT TECHNOLOGIES designs, builds, and maintains custom digital systems for startups, SMEs, and local enterprises across India and overseas:
- **Web Development in Kadapa:** Modern Next.js, React, and TypeScript web applications engineered for speed, conversion, and local SEO.
- **Custom Software Development:** Tailored ERPs, inventory management systems, and workflow automation.
- **QA Automation & Testing Pods:** Dedicated SDET engineers deploying Selenium, Playwright, TestNG, and CI/CD pipelines for zero-defect software releases.
- **AI Software Engineering:** Agentic AI, WhatsApp business automation bots, intelligent document processing, and RAG search systems.
- **Mobile App Development:** Native performance iOS and Android applications built using Google Flutter.
- **SaaS Product Engineering:** Multi-tenant cloud software with subscription billing and role-based access control.
- **Business Software & Retail Systems:** POS billing software, GST invoicing, thermal printing integration, and barcode scanner support.

### 2. MOMO Academy (Career Training & Practical Internships)
MOMO Academy provides job-ready, mentor-led software engineering and test automation training for engineering students, fresh graduates, and career changers:
- **Automation Testing Training in Kadapa:** Comprehensive Selenium 4, TestNG, Cucumber BDD framework, REST Assured API testing, Git, and Jenkins CI/CD.
- **Core & Advanced Java Training:** OOP principles, Java Collections, Multi-threading, Exception Handling, JDBC, and Spring Boot basics.
- **Selenium Training:** Hands-on automation framework design, Page Object Model (POM), data-driven testing with Apache POI, and test execution reporting.
- **Full-Stack Development Training:** React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, and cloud deployment on Vercel/Render.
- **Flutter Mobile App Training:** Dart programming, Flutter UI widgets, Provider/Bloc state management, REST API integration, and Firebase backend.
- **Agentic AI & Python Training:** Python foundations, OpenAI/Gemini API integrations, LangChain, vector embeddings, and autonomous agent workflows.
- **Verified Credentials & Internship Letters:** Every graduate works on real client codebases and receives an official, BGV-verifiable certificate with a permanent verification record at `https://www.momoittechnologies.com/certificates`.

---

## Client Proof & Live Case Studies
- **Vijaya's Yummy Food (Kadapa):** Engineered a cloud-based restaurant POS and digital QR ordering system, reducing kitchen ticket delays by 40% and eliminating manual billing errors.
- **MANA Tours & Travels (Kadapa):** Built an automated outstation taxi booking, fleet scheduling, and driver dispatch portal, increasing direct online ride reservations by 3x.
- **MomoPe:** Proprietary fintech merchant payment and customer rewards platform designed for regional retail ecosystems.
